anonymize_student._CRITICAL: Requires the `X-Confirm-Destructive: true` HTTP header. An API-level confirmation gate distinct from OAuth scope - reproduce it, and surface a clear error when absent rather than a bare 4xx.

attributes.password: string, required - must meet the organization's password policy

send_password_reset.desc: Send a password reset email. `?domain=learn.example.com` is required - the reset link is domain-scoped, so there is no sensible default.

item._extra: forbid - unknown keys (e.g. a stray attributes block copied from POST /v2/students/) surface as 422 at the schema layer rather than a silent no-op

add_group_memberships.semantics: IDEMPOTENT per JSON:API to-many POST. Already a member returns the existing membership as `succeeded` - there is no `already_a_member` error code. Duplicates within a batch are first-wins, later ones pre-marked `duplicate_in_batch` at /data/{i}/id.
add_group_memberships._ordering: The group lookup runs BEFORE the envelope guard, so a missing group is 404 regardless of body content - clients cannot infer group existence from the 400-vs-404 boundary. Deliberate; preserve it.

remove_group_memberships.semantics: IDEMPOTENT per JSON:API to-many DELETE. A non-member returns status "deleted" - there is no `not_a_member` outcome on the wire (a service-level discriminator tracks it for audit and event dispatch). First-wins duplicates. 404 if the group is not in the caller's org.

params.expires_at: date-time|null (top level, optional, must be in the future)

attributes.email: string(email), required - normalized to lowercase server-side

bulk_enroll_students._envelope: HYBRID: published_course_id and expires_at are shared at the TOP level; data carries per-row items. Not a plain batch envelope - reproduce this shape exactly.
bulk_enroll_students.responses: 200 all succeeded | 207 any failed | 400 empty envelope, over cap, or a past expires_at (request-level)
bulk_enroll_students.semantics: Rows processed independently. First-wins duplicate detection on email; later occurrences pre-marked `duplicate_in_batch` without reaching the service.
bulk_enroll_students._see_also: api_v2/docs/enrollments.md - per-row failure-code vocabulary, reactivation behaviour, retry contract. Not public; the vocabulary must be learned empirically.

complete_enrollments.desc: Set or remove course completion on a batch of enrollments.
complete_enrollments._note: `send_notifications` is REQUIRED, not defaulted - the caller is forced to decide whether learners get email. Preserve that; defaulting it silently mails people.
